about: 2026-11-22 rumblecrash: a short Royal Rumble PLAYED by player 1 -- BRET HART at controller 1 (the human path: walk_by_stick from the pad, the stick the crash's call came through), five more entrants drawn as a player's Rumble draws them (no QA draw list), one every 10 s, a CPU man put outside every 4 s (qa_rr_out) so it reaches a decision. Pad 1's script: every 8 s from 40 s, the left stick (the d-pad's walk by default) left 1.2 s, B (strike) x2, the left stick up 1.2 s, A (grapple) then A, the right stick (the N64 stick) right 1.2 s, B. Checks: the Rumble started, player 1 on a controller all match, he moved, nobody's position went bad, the Rumble decided.

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: player 1 (slot 0) still on controller 1 after the bell (a CPU-played test's slot goes to the CPU at match frame 60) -- the human path
player 1 moved (more than 40 from the Rumble's first place, x -180 z 180)
nobody's position went bad
expect.check: finite(s0_x, s0_y, s0_z, s1_x, s1_y, s1_z, s2_x, s2_y, s2_z)
